draft_en.subject: A price band below LevelOne, Zyxel and DrayTek for your Hong Kong SIs
draft_en.body:
Hi Allen,

We wrote to you once in February 2025 about a 90 W PoE managed switch, and since then only general product mails - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 15 September 2026 - none of which needed an answer. This one is specific.

Alongside the LevelOne, Zyxel and DrayTek switches you distribute to Hong Kong SIs, a neutral-brand band below them, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5. Shenzhen is next door, so a sample is a day away.

One question: is there a price band your SIs ask for below the branded lines, or do they stay with the names?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
